entities.name: Kalyntri
entities.description: Vicious, arrogant dragon who terrorized the Kapsho Sea of Shandalar for over three hundred years until slain by Talrand's drakes.

entities.name: Talrand the Sky Summoner
entities.description: Merfolk who summoned drakes and killed Kalyntri.

entities.name: Kapsho Sea
entities.description: Sea of Shandalar ruled by Kalyntri as his kingdom.

entities.name: Drakes
entities.description: Creatures summoned by Talrand, delivered from dragon rule in return for their aid.

events.summary: Talrand visits one of Kalyntri's lairs; Kalyntri blasts him with flame but the merfolk had teleported away.
events.quote: The merfolk had teleported away before being struck by the fire.

events.summary: Talrand returns a year later proclaiming dominion over the Kapsho seas, enraging Kalyntri.
events.quote: Kalyntri was enraged and sought the merfolk out to eliminate him once and for all.

events.summary: Talrand summons rain made of drakes which overwhelm Kalyntri.
events.quote: the raindrops were not made of water, but of drakes

events.summary: A geyser topples Kalyntri onto the beach and the drakes swarm him; one tears out his throat.
events.quote: The drake then eagerly scampered over to Kalyntri's struggling body and tore out the dragon's throat.

relations.quote: The drake then eagerly scampered over to Kalyntri's struggling body and tore out the dragon's throat.
until he was slain by Talrand the Sky Summoner and his drakes
Talrand summoned forth large drops of rain from the stormcloud above
